== Notes ==
* Wild Throw disables all attack skills that are not [[spear attack]] skills, rather than disabling ''all'' skills that are not spear attack skills. [[Wastrel's Collapse]] shares a similar drawback by disabling non-dagger attack skills.

==Hero Usage==
*Heroes will use this as a generic damage skill and won't save it for removing stances.
